author: vicoooo26
liveNote: No live layer. The sandbox cluster is a shared Aliyun ACK v1.36 with no kind binary and no training-operator; creating clusters or installing CRDs there was deliberately avoided. F1490-1 was reproduced against that cluster only in the read-only sense (the BeforeSuite gate's kubectl get returns NotFound). To exercise the e2e suite for real, run `make v2-e2e-setup-cluster` on a throwaway kind host.

findings.claim: No file under test/e2e declares //go:build v2e2e, so `go test ./...` compiles the cluster-dependent Ginkgo suite and dies in BeforeSuite. #1490 adds a second Fail() (training-operator gate) which fires even after `make arena-v2`.
findings.proposedFix: Add `//go:build v2e2e` as the first line of every test/e2e/*.go. The Makefile v2-e2e-test target must then pass -tags v2e2e (it currently does not on develop-v2).

findings.claim: hack/e2e-setup-cluster.sh's INSTALL_METHOD=helm branch is unreachable: CHART_PATH defaults to charts/kubeflow-trainer but training-operator v1.9.3 ships no charts/ directory at all, so the branch always exits 1.
findings.proposedFix: Drop the helm branch and the install_method input (KISS — the CI matrix only uses kustomize), or repoint CHART_PATH and pin a TRAINER_REF that actually ships the chart.

findings.claim: The BeforeSuite gate hardcodes deploy/training-operator in namespace "kubeflow" while the setup script exposes NAMESPACE, and the helm branch may name the Deployment after the release; a correctly provisioned non-default namespace is then rejected.
findings.proposedFix: Read the namespace (and ideally the deployment name) from an env var that the setup script also sets, or drop the gate and let the existing CRD check carry it.

findings.claim: docs/best-practices.md annotates both mount_path and shm as "Optional" with defaults, but task.Storage.Validate rejects an empty mount_path and there is no default shm size, so either omission fails to load. Corollary: pkg/provider/interface.go's SHM mount-path defaulting is unreachable via LoadFromFile, and pkg/provider/interface_test.go only passes because it bypasses Validate.
findings.proposedFix: Either drop the two "Optional" annotations from the doc, or relax Storage.Validate to allow an empty mount_path when SHM is set (and add a default size) so the provider's existing defaulting becomes reachable. Prefer the latter — the code already intends it and has a unit test for it.

findings.claim: docs/cli-reference.md documents `arena job submit <type>` in four examples, but submitCmd is registered on the root command, so the nested form fails.

HYPOTHESIS NOT REPRODUCED — the 16 new reference/ and pretrain/ examples were suspected of being unvalidated-and-broken. All 20 examples/v2/**.yaml load cleanly. The residual gap is coverage, not correctness: examplesDir() was narrowed to examples/v2/quickstart, so 16 of the 20 are exercised by nothing.
findings.proposedFix: Optional but cheap: walk examples/v2 recursively in the existing pkg/cli table test so new examples cannot rot. This test is the upstream-worthy part of the harness.

findings.claim: v0.15.5 is not published upstream (only v0.15.4), so the re-release motivation is real. But push_tag runs a bare `git tag -a v$VERSION && git push` with no existence guard, and draft_release needs push_tag, while build-arena-image/release-image have already re-pushed ghcr.io/kubeflow/arena:$VERSION. The advertised manual re-release therefore works exactly once; every later dispatch mutates the published image and then fails without producing a release.
findings.proposedFix: Make push_tag idempotent (skip when the tag exists, or `git tag -f` + `git push --force` if re-pointing is intended) and gate the image push the same way.

findings.claim: workflow_dispatch is added with no branch guard while the push trigger is limited to master + paths:VERSION. A dispatch runs on whatever ref it is launched from and the release uses target_commitish: github.sha.
findings.proposedFix: Add `if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'` to the jobs, or guard at the workflow level.
